title: Analysts’ Price Target Changes for May, 2nd (AAPL, COHR, GE, INTC, KER, MCD, MSFT, PFE, SYY, TDOC)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on May 2nd, 2018 // No Comments
Analysts’ price target changes for Wednesday, May 2nd:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $197.00 target price by analysts at Macquarie. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $185.00 target price by analysts at Atlantic Securities. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $175.00 price target by analysts at Morningstar, Inc.. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Coherent (NASDAQ:COHR) had its price target lowered by Needham & Company LLC to $250.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
General Electric (NYSE:GE) was given a $19.00 target price by analysts at Morningstar, Inc.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) was given a $62.00 target price by analysts at Morningstar, Inc.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Kering (EPA:KER) was given a €456.00 ($556.10) target price by analysts at BNP Paribas. The firm currently has a sell rating on the stock.
McDonald's (NYSE:MCD) was given a $204.00 target price by analysts at Barclays. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) was given a $117.00 target price by analysts at Morningstar, Inc.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) was given a $43.50 price target by analysts at Morningstar, Inc.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Sysco (NYSE:SYY) had its price target cut by Pivotal Research from $61.00 to $56.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Teladoc (NYSE:TDOC) had its price target boosted by SunTrust Banks to $48.00. They currently have a positive rating on the stock.
Walmart (NYSE:WMT) was given a $99.00 price target by analysts at Stifel Nicolaus. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Walmart (NYSE:WMT) was given a $91.00 price target by analysts at Morningstar, Inc.. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
